First, consult the enumeration dictionary for this release. The enumeration dictionary for ResStock 2025 Release 1 is available on OEDI and describes the column names and possible values for each column. The enumeration dictionary for this dataset release will be in a folder like oedi- data-lake/nlr-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025. For this measure upgrade, the primary columns of interest are in.infiltration, in.insulation_ceiling, and in.duct_leakage_and_insulation. Electrical panel constraint modeling was added to ResStock via OpenStudio-HPXML measures in 2025 to assess whether the existing panel has enough capacity or breaker space to accommodate new loads from an energy retrofit. For details on panel constraint modeling, refer to the ResStock Technical Reference Guide (Reyna, et al., 2025). This measures does not introduce new electrical loads or circuits, so it has no impact on the electrical panel. However, electrical panel metrics are included as a standard output for this and all other envelope measures.
